name: qwen3.8-27b
about: Alibaba Qwen3.8, 27B dense, FP8 as published by Qwen. Thinking mode off, so it answers directly like gpt-oss at low reasoning effort. Apache-2.0. A hybrid (linear-attention) model: vLLM's default of 256 sequences exceeds its state cache on a 48 GB card, hence --max-num-seqs 64.
